name: Logo Sting
tagline: A 5–8 second logo reveal in six looks (line, particles, liquid, ink, glass, chrome), with a transparent version for any edit.
youSay: /logo-sting reveal my logo.svg in liquid, 6 seconds, plus a transparent version for my editor
whatYouGet: A 5–8 second reveal or outro that ends on your real logo, crisp
Six looks: the outline drawing itself, particles settling, a liquid bead, ink blooming into paper, a glass lens, polished chrome
MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, and a transparent ProRes 4444 .mov and WebM to drop over any video
Works from an SVG, a transparent PNG or just your name set in your typeface
goodFit: Intros and outros for launch films, ads, podcasts and channels
Bumpers and end cards for social videos
notFor: Long brand films or character animation
youBring: Your logo as SVG or transparent PNG (or your name and typeface)
Optional: your colours and a tagline or URL
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
